# Vercel Workflow corpus (paper §12.3 stand-in)

Sources copied from [vercel/workflow](https://github.com/vercel/workflow) workbench:

- `workbench/vitest/workflows/**`
- `workbench/example/workflows/**` (excluding helpers, serde-only, stress 96–97, large e2e 99–100)

Upstream HEAD at import time: see `SOURCE_COMMIT` below.

License: Apache-2.0 (same as upstream Workflow SDK).

Paper reference: arXiv:2607.13617 §12.3 (commit 39673b7 cited; this import uses a newer workbench snapshot with the same directory layout).
